Loading contacts
sourceFacts: Exact wrapper props/slots/native output from sources/react-api-inventory.json and pinned code.
contentAlternative: The host supplies Loading contacts as the meaningful status; the source skeleton geometry is explicitly hidden in this reference.
updatesAndDescendants: Skeleton itself is a div with animate-pulse and inherited props. The caller owns loading/data/error and aria-busy, replaces placeholder shapes with content after completion, and reports failure instead of pulsing forever. Reduced motion stops placeholder animation without removing status text.
referenceDecision: The labelled busy region, status text, aria-hidden and motion policy are authorized reference composition decisions, not built-in behavior claimed for the bare Skeleton wrapper.
keyboard: This default content wrapper does not install a keyboard listener or roving focus. Native links/buttons/inputs in the chosen children retain their own documented semantics. Label delegates native focus through its associated control.
naming: The HTML projection identifies all required visible content/labels. No unnecessary ARIA role/name is imposed on native text, headings, kbd or tables.

placeholder.description: Decorative loading geometry; host owns meaningful busy/status text.
